title: Dratini's Life Energy Forces Repeated Skin Sheds

direction.premise: Dratini repeatedly sheds its skin because life energy steadily builds inside it to uncontrollable levels.
direction.audiencePromise: See how rising life energy turns repeated skin shedding into Dratini's growth cycle.
direction.openLoop: How does uncontrollable energy become a growth cycle?
direction.payoff: Uncontrollable life energy becomes Dratini's growth cycle: shed skin, grow larger, then build again.
direction.engagementQuestion: Is repeated shedding a growth advantage or an energy response?

voice.instructions: Quick, warm, and curious. Stress “keeps building,” “uncontrollable,” and “almost daily.” Pause briefly before the final either-or question.

scenes.headline: THE GROWTH RESET
scenes.narration: Dratini's life energy keeps building, forcing repeated skin sheds.
scenes.caption: LIFE ENERGY: UNCONTROLLABLE

scenes.headline: BORN LARGE, GROWS LONGER
scenes.narration: Dratini is born large, then sheds repeatedly as it grows longer.
scenes.caption: SHED SKIN TO GROW LONGER

scenes.headline: ENERGY HITS THE LIMIT
scenes.narration: Inside, life energy steadily builds toward uncontrollable levels.
scenes.caption: ENERGY REACHES UNCONTROLLABLE LEVELS

scenes.headline: SHED THE OLD SKIN
scenes.narration: That buildup triggers another shed, clearing old skin away.
scenes.caption: BUILDUP → SHED OLD SKIN

scenes.headline: ALMOST DAILY
scenes.narration: That cycle lets Dratini keep growing longer as energy builds again.
scenes.caption: SHED → GROW → BUILD AGAIN
